title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Shonen Anime Unleashes Its Hero’s Terrifying New Transformation, But It’s Surprisingly Cute
content: The Summer of 2026 is also featuring a brand-new shonen anime, which is currently airing on Crunchyroll . The series has rapidly progressed and is already featuring the classic shonen hero transformation that other series take much longer to introduce.
author: ComicBook

title: Sendai Books Licenses Amazoness Kiss, Never Mind Come Together Manga in English
content: European publisher Sendai Books announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Wednesday it will publish Natsuko Ishitsuyo 's Amazoness Kiss manga and Xian Ozn 's Never Mind Come Together manga in English.
author: ANN

title: OSHI NO KO Season 4 (Final Season) Teaser Visual and Trailer Revealed
content: The previously announced final season, OSHI NO KO Season 4 revealed a teaser visual and trailer. The announcement was made at the Ichigo Production☆Fan Thanksgiving 2026 event held on August 16.
author: Anime Corner

title: Reincarnated as a Sword Season 2 Reveals September 30 Early Streaming Debut, Theme Songs in Trailer
content: The website for the television anime of Yuu Tanaka and LLO 's Reincarnated as a Sword ( Tensei Shitara Ken Deshita ) light novel series revealed on Sunday the September 30 streaming debut, October 7 television debut, and a new key visual for the anime's second season .
author: ANN

title: Skip & Loafer Anime's 2nd Season Reveals April 2027 Debut in Teaser Video
content: The official website for the television anime of Misaki Takamatsu 's Skip and Loafer ( Skip to Loafer ) manga revealed in a teaser video the April 2027 debut of the show's second season . Kotomi Deai ( Natsume's Book of Friends ) returns from the first season to direct and oversee the series scripts at P.A. Works .
author: ANN

title: Skip and Loafer Season 2 Teaser Trailer Reveals April 2027 Release
content: Skip and Loafer Season 2 anime revealed the first teaser trailer and visual, along with an April 2027 release date. The anime previously confirmed the main staff members were returning for the sequel , including Kotomi Deai as the director at studio P.A. Works. You can watch the new trailer below. Studio P.A.
author: Anime Corner

title: Toryumon Takeda's Doga Manga Ends in 7th Volume
content: The sixth volume of Toryumon Takeda 's DOGA manga announced on July 24 the series will end in the seventh volume, which will ship in winter 2026. An early promotional image for the series described the story: Yote is as high-ranked as he is unaware of the reality of the world.
author: ANN

title: Patlabor the Case Files Game Debuts on September 17
content: Good Smile Company started streaming a trailer for it and developer Chime Corporation 's Patlabor the Case Files , a new 3D action game based on the Patlabor franchise , on Monday. The video reveals the game's September 17 release date. The game's Steam page describes the story: Labors.
author: ANN

title: Boruto Manga Takes 1-Month Break
content: Manga storywriter Ukyō Kodachi and Mikio Ikemoto launched the Boruto sequel manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in May 2016, and the manga ran monthly in the magazine. The manga transferred to V Jump in July 2019.
author: ANN

title: 2 Years Ago, Dragon Ball Ended a Disappointing 56 Episode Series You Probably Haven’t Watched Yet
content: Over four decades ago, the world of Shonen series changed forever as Akira Toriyama’s Dragon Ball debuted in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine. The series left a permanent mark on the industry as one of the most iconic franchises in the history of Shonen and became one of the most influential series of all time.
author: ComicBook
